Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification of the right hemithorax with a contralateral (leftward) mediastinal shift, which is the classic radiographic presentation of a massive right-sided pleural effusion. Atelectasis would cause an ipsilateral shift, while pneumonia typically does not cause significant mediastinal displacement.
